capture_mode: conservative contemporaneous press address enrichment of saved Savills catalogue rows
source_note: Contemporaneous press coverage was checked across the three newly banked 2005 first-page Savills catalogue grids. The May coverage did not expose a unique numbered street address for a saved row and the July route yielded no defensible address evidence. The Irish Independent preview for the 24 October auction states the exact auction date and 52-lot catalogue denominator and identifies four properties by full address, property type, locality and compatible guide price. Each has a single compatible row in the saved first-party Savills Auc 412 grid. Only those four unique mappings are retained; all other appearances remain unchanged and all repeat appearances remain separate. This enrichment file sorts after its target source file so the deterministic corpus rebuild applies the evidence after regenerating the target shard.

source_records.evidence_excerpt: Published 19 October 2005, the preview identifies the Monday 24 October Savills commercial auction and its 52-lot catalogue. It names four properties: 8 Gatton Place in Redhill, 11 Old Farm Road in Ayr, Olympia House in Iver, and The Old Fire Station at 244 Shepherd's Bush Road in London, with property types and guide prices compatible with the saved Savills grid.
